top_signals.title: Billions on the line for Berkshire utility as Oregon's high court reviews wildfire claims
top_signals.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's PacifiCorp and attorneys for thousands of plaintiffs are welcoming a decision by Oregon's Supreme Court to widen its review of a 2023 lower court trial in which a jury awarded more than one billion in damages over four wildfires in 2020.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Travel Demand Holds Despite Higher Prices
top_signals.summary: Travelers are heading into 2027 facing higher airfares and hotel rates, as strong demand boosts cruises and changing travel patterns put pressure on theme parks. On Bloomberg This Weekend, senior credit analyst of Bloomberg Intelligence Jody Lurie and aviation and travel correspondent at Flighty Katie Mastro tell hosts Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo why consumers are still prioritizing travel despite rising costs and fewer low-cost options. (Source: Bloomberg)
